example: I miss my mom and dad a lot.
我很想念我的爸爸媽媽。
[ as form of address ] Aw, Mom, why can't I go?
哦，媽媽，為甚麼我不能去？
All the moms were waiting in the schoolyard.
所有的媽媽們都在學校操場上等著。
She loves being a mom.
她喜歡當媽媽。

NONE: › used to describe a small business that is owned and operated by members of the same family

example: a mom-and-pop business/store
一家夫妻公司／店

C: A2 [ C ] a very short period of time
B1 [ C ] a particular time or occasion
B2 If you do something for the moment, you are doing it now, but might do something different in the future.

example: Can you wait a moment?
你能等一下嗎？
I'll be ready in just a moment.
我一會兒就準備好。
A car drew up outside and a few moments later the doorbell rang.
一輛車在門外停下來了，過了一會兒門鈴就響了。
I'm expecting her to come at any moment (= very soon).
我預計她隨時會來。
Have you got a moment (= are you busy or do you have time to speak to me)?
你有空嗎？
When would be the best moment to tell the family?
甚麼時候告訴家人最好？
Don't leave it to/till the last moment (= the latest time possible).
不要拖到最後一刻。
If you want a private conversation with her you'll have to choose your moment (= find a suitable time).
如果你想私下和她談談，必須選好時機。
The moment (that) (= as soon as) I get the money I'll send the ticket.
我一收到錢就會把票寄出。
Sorry, she's not here at the moment.
對不起，她現在不在這兒。
Let's keep doing what we agreed for the moment.
我們暫時還是繼續按照雙方原來議定的去做吧。
I can give no information at this precise moment in time.
我現在不能提供任何資訊。
a decision of great moment
重大的決定

momentous

她一時被那些外國路標搞糊塗了。
I'll be ready to leave momentarily.
我馬上就準備好要走了。

NONE: › lasting for a very short time

example: a momentary hesitation
片刻的猶豫

NONE: › very important because of effects on future events

example: the momentous news of the president's death
總統去世的重大消息
Whether or not to move overseas was a momentous decision for the family.
是否移居海外對這個家庭來說是個重要的決定。

NONE: C2 the force that keeps an object moving or keeps an event developing after it has started
動量，衝量；衝力；推動力；動力

example: Once you push it, it keeps going under its own momentum.
一旦你推動了它，它就會在自己的動量作用下持續運動。
The spacecraft will fly around the earth to gain/gather momentum for its trip to Jupiter.
太空船將繞著地球飛行以獲取飛向木星所需的動力。
The play loses momentum (= becomes less interesting, energetic, etc.) by its half way stage.
這部戲演到一半時就沒看頭了。
In an attempt to give new momentum to their plans, the committee set a date for starting detailed discussions.
為了為他們的計劃賦予新的動力，委員會定好了開始討論細節的日期。
I want my mommy.
我要我媽媽。
[ as form of address ] I'm thirsty, Mommy.
媽媽，我渇。
